preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or authorized address
Contract must have trading enabled (tradingOpen = true)
Attacker must hold some amount of the Allin token to pay fees

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setFees() function with extremely high fee values (e.g., 5000 for each fee component and feeDenominator = 10000). This will set totalFee to 20000, making the fee 200% of each transaction. Then perform a token swap or transfer to trigger fee collection, which will accumulate excessive fees in the contract. Finally, call manualSend() to transfer the accumulated BNB to the marketingFeeReceiver (which should be controlled by the attacker).
